description.value: Matoi Sushi is an authentic Japanese restaurant in Coquitlam serving sushi, sashimi, nigiri, and fusion rolls alongside a curated sake and shochu list. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, with a dedicated online ordering system for to-go orders. Cyclists looking for a sit-down meal near the Lougheed Highway corridor will find a relaxed, locally popular spot with lunch specials and vegetarian options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms this is an active Japanese sushi restaurant. The website clearly identifies the business as located in Coquitlam (not North Vancouver as the OSM community field states), at #490-3025 Lougheed Hwy, Coquitlam, BC V3B 6S2, with phone (604) 464-2778 and email matoisushi@hotmail.com matching OSM. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('VIEW OUR TOGO MENU', online ordering), and a 'Vegetarian Suggestion Menu' confirms vegetarian options; no other amenity evidence appears on the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Coquitlam per the website and the full address (#490-3025 Lougheed Hwy, Coquitlam, BC V3B 6S2). OSM address is also incomplete (missing street name 'Lougheed Hwy'); website provides the full address which has been used here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Japanese restaurant with confirmed takeout and online ordering — a practical stop for touring cyclists on the Lougheed Highway corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian Suggestion Menu' under menu options. No vegan or GF confirmation found
